property_summary: Calling C.transfer does not change the public getters from and caddress; if the call returns (does not revert) then msg.sender equals the stored from and the _tos array is non-empty.
If C.transfer returns normally then it returns true and does not change the public getters from and caddress.

If transfer reverts then either msg.sender wasn't the authorized from address or the _tos array was empty or some v[i] is nonzero and causes the multiplication/division check to fail; otherwise transfer returns true and does not modify c.from or c.caddress getters.
Calling transfer does not change c.from (the stored authorized sender) when transfer is invoked with matching array lengths.
For any non-empty _tos array with matching v length and all v[i] either zero or safe for 1e18-scaling, a successful transfer call returns true and does not change c.caddress() or c.from().

If transfer is called with a non-empty _tos array and matching v length where every v[i] is either 0 or safe for 1e18-scaling, then the call cannot both succeed (return true) and change c.from(); i.e., a successful call preserves c.from().
When transfer returns true for valid inputs it preserves c.from() (the authorized sender) — a successful call cannot change c.from().

If transfer returns (i.e., does not revert) then it must return true and not change c.from or c.caddress getters; also it only succeeds when msg.sender is the configured from address and the _tos array is non-empty and each v element either zero or not causing multiplication overflow (i.e., the require regarding scaled division holds).
If transfer does not revert when called from this test contract with a single recipient, it must return true and must not change the public getters from() and caddress().
